column9: Immediately after the Attack action, make two Unarmed Strikes as a Bonus Action.
Take the Dodge action as a Bonus Action.

column4: note:Disengage or Dash; jump distance doubled
column9: Take the Disengage or Dash action as a Bonus Action; your jump distance is doubled.
Regain Hit Points equal to 1d10 plus your Fighter level.
Take one additional action on your turn.
When you roll Initiative, regain all expended uses of Rage (once per Long Rest).
Enter a Rage as a Bonus Action if you aren't wearing Heavy armor.
As a Bonus Action, you shape-shift into a Beast form that you have learned for this feature.
When you roll Initiative, regain all expended Focus Points and roll your Martial Arts die + your Monk level to regain that many Hit Points (once per Long Rest).

column4: note:Cast Find Familiar without Material components
column9: As a Magic action, you can expend a use of Wild Shape to cast the Find Familiar spell without Material components. When you cast the spell in this way, the familiar is Fey and disappears when you finish a Long Rest.
You can expend one use of Wild Shape (no action required) to give yourself a level 1 spell slot, but you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

As a Magic action, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape and choose a point within 60 feet of yourself. Each creature of your choice in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point must make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC, taking 2d6 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. One creature of your choice in that area regains 2d6 Hit Points. The damage and healing increase by 1d6 when you reach Druid levels 10 (3d6) and 14 (4d6).

column4: note:Spectral trees and vines fill a 15-foot Cube within 120 feet for 1 minute
column9: As a Magic action, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape and cause spectral trees and vines to appear in a 15-foot Cube on the ground within 120 feet of yourself. They last there for 1 minute or until you have the Incapacitated condition or die. You and your allies have Half Cover while in that area, and your allies gain the current Resistance of your Nature's Ward while there. As a Bonus Action, you can move the Cube up to 60 feet to ground within 120 feet of yourself.
